description:
This dataset provides annual coastline positions across the Pacific region derived from Landsat satellite imagery. It captures long-term shoreline change by mapping coastal boundaries over time. The dataset supports coastal change analysis, erosion monitoring, and climate adaptation planning.

Lineage:
Derived from Landsat imagery by extracting and compositing annual shoreline vectors.

Processing level:
Feature Extraction

Dataset type:
Vector time series
